text:
The man likely prevails. When the woman conveyed the house to the man, he came to own both the dominant and servient parcels, so the easement was extinguished by merger. His later warranty deed conveyed only the house, and a conveyance of the dominant parcel alone doesn't revive the easement without a new grant, nor does the man's use of the path create an implied easement, since he never used it.

CONFIDENCE: 88
